description.value: Sunshine Market is a long-established neighbourhood grocery store on Oak Street in Vancouver, having served the community for over sixty years. It focuses on fresh produce and a broad range of everyday groceries, making it a practical resupply stop for cyclists passing through the city. The store is independently operated with a friendly, community-oriented character.
